title: Florida insurance agents: licensee, agency-owner, and business-phone evidence kept separate
hypothesis: The FL DFS individual file proves a current individual insurance license and may contain a published business phone. It does not prove agency ownership, independent status, direct line, or mobile status. An owner label requires an independently sourced, explicit agency role for the same person.
ownerSource: No implemented owner source exists for Florida insurance agencies. The FL DFS Business and active-appointment downloads are listed in the catalog, but the needed owner, agent-in-charge, or DRLP columns are UNKNOWN and no runtime adapter ingests them. Individual license, name match, appointment/carrier count, address, or phone is not owner proof.
phoneSource: FL DFS AllValidLicensesIndividual.csv is parsed as a published Business Phone on a VALID individual-license row. It is business-contact evidence only; frequency over three rows or equality with a credible agency/Maps phone is agency-line evidence, never a direct licensee mobile.

workflow.label: Public-source eligibility gate
workflow.detail: Use only the documented FL DFS individual-license download. Do not use residential, paid, private, or prohibited sources.

workflow.label: VALID individual DFS license
workflow.detail: Parse a person row only when License Status is VALID; retain title and provenance as FL DFS licensee.

workflow.label: Hold invalid, entity, or out-of-cohort row
workflow.detail: Reject non-VALID or non-person rows and hold license types outside an explicit approved producer cohort.

workflow.label: Separate licensee from agency owner
workflow.detail: A license proves licensure only. Do not infer owner, principal, independent agent, or captive owner-operator from appointment/carrier count, name, address, or phone.

workflow.label: Published business-phone contrast
workflow.detail: Use recipe-D phone frequency and credible agency/Maps comparison before verification; retain the register value as business-contact evidence.

workflow.label: Hold shared or office business line
workflow.detail: Park repeated, equal-to-agency/Maps, absent, or weakly matched numbers without assigning them to the licensee.

workflow.label: Independent explicit agency role
workflow.detail: Require a separately ingested, schema-validated agency row explicitly naming the same person as owner, principal, agent in charge, or DRLP.

workflow.label: Hold licensee without owner evidence
workflow.detail: No current Florida adapter supplies an explicit agency-owner edge; do not promote the licensee.

workflow.label: Normal contact gates
workflow.detail: Apply mobile line type, live, DNC, suppression, and dedupe checks after ownership evidence. A business phone remains unconfirmed until these pass.

workflow.label: Hold failed contact evidence
workflow.detail: Park non-mobile, unreachable, suppressed, shared, or otherwise failed contacts.

workflow.label: Deliver supported owner classification
workflow.detail: Deliver only after independent owner-role evidence and every contact/compliance gate pass.

edges.label: shared, office, absent, or weakly matched line

failures.risk: The brain selects recipe C although the adapter and catalog identify this register as recipe D, bypassing the shared business-phone comparison.
failures.mitigation: Change insurance_agent_fl to recipe D and add a synthetic quote/bucket regression before any provider-enabled run.

failures.risk: A VALID individual licensee is labeled an independent agency owner from an appointment/carrier count that the runtime never ingests.
failures.mitigation: Remove the unimplemented owner-filter claim and persist only FL DFS licensee provenance until a separate explicit agency-role source is validated and ingested.

failures.risk: A shared agency office phone is presented as the individual licensee's direct mobile.
failures.mitigation: Use phone frequency and credible agency/Maps contrast first; hold shared/equal business lines and apply normal contact gates only afterward.

failures.risk: All VALID license types, including adjusters, enter an insurance-agent pipeline.
failures.mitigation: Add an explicit producer-license allowlist or hold non-producer types; current flDfsRecord accepts Adjuster - All Lines.

failures.risk: Business-file or appointment columns are assumed to prove ownership without a verified schema or matched role.
failures.mitigation: Keep the owner branch blocked until the public Business file is schema-checked and an explicit person-to-agency role is implemented.

iterations.hypothesis: A VALID FL DFS individual license row identifies an independent agency owner and a direct owner phone.
iterations.test: Five-case local flDfsRecord and dedupeNames fixture/code audit on 2026-09-24: General Lines, Adjuster - All Lines, non-VALID, entity-shaped name, and a second license class with the same person/phone. No network or provider call.
iterations.observed: The parser keeps VALID General Lines, Adjuster, and second-class person rows with a published business phone; it skips non-VALID and entity-shaped rows. Deduplication collapses repeated licensee IDs but does not model agency ownership, appointment count, phone frequency, agency relation, mobile status, or owner evidence.
iterations.change: Describe the source as licensee plus business-contact evidence only. Hold owner classification pending an independently ingested explicit agency role and route phone handling through recipe D.

iterations.hypothesis: The brain's three-plus-carrier and single-captive appointment rules are current runtime filters.
iterations.test: Static audit of insurance_agent_fl brain metadata, REGISTER_ADAPTERS, flDfsRecord, and the mapped register source.
iterations.observed: Only fl_dfs_individual is mapped and it parses no appointment or Business-file fields. The brain selects C while its adapter declares D; the catalog also hints D for shared-phone contrast.
iterations.change: Correct the shared metadata and recipe before enabling an insurance-agent owner workflow; do not report carrier count as independence or ownership evidence.

measurement.result: Five local parser/code cases only. VALID person licensees retain a published business phone; a VALID Adjuster also passes; invalid and entity rows are rejected; duplicate license classes dedupe by licensee ID. No external source, contact value, mobile status, live result, DNC result, owner relationship, or delivery was measured.

cost.basis: Fixture/code audit only; no provider or paid verification call
cost.note: No clean delivered owner contact was observed. Historical brain estimates have a different unverified denominator and do not establish a per-clean cost.

implementation.summary: The individual-license adapter is implemented, but its C-configured route bypasses the documented D phone contrast and has no implemented independent agency-owner evidence. The metadata's appointment/carrier owner filter is not backed by a mapped source or runtime parser.

nextMeasurement: After root corrects the shared route, run five synthetic recipe-D/job cases: unique credible business phone, repeated agency phone, register phone equal to Maps phone, valid adjuster, and a separately ingested explicit agency-owner role. Assert that only the last can carry owner-candidate provenance; all contacts still require mobile/live/DNC/suppression/dedupe gates. Then run an authorized aggregate public-source study with separate licensee, producer-eligible, unique-phone, shared-phone, explicit-role, and delivery denominators.
